changelog:
Initial release of afrexai-devops-engine — a complete DevOps & Platform Engineering system.

- Covers the full DevOps lifecycle: repository strategy, CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and platform practices.
- Provides practical templates for branch protection, commit conventions, and pipeline design for all major CI tools.
- Includes best practices for Dockerfile creation, image optimization, container security, and local development setup.
- Features adaptable guides on caching strategies, pipeline concurrency, and reusable workflow patterns.
- Designed for any team size, release cadence, and major cloud/platform environments.
